decision_question: Can one flow-independent, gold-isolated harness compare the four tutoring conditions across multi-turn, long-horizon, restart, failure, and proactive scenarios before provider-backed execution?
boundaries: This checkpoint qualifies the reusable evaluation harness; it is not product-quality evidence.
The reference driver is deterministic and receives scripted observable behavior only for harness validation.
Actual product adapters must receive public cases only; gold joins after durable responses.
No provider call, release selection, professor-fidelity claim, or human outcome claim is permitted.
